summary: Seattle, software engineer, strong interest in programming languages and frameworks, advocates for basic income and social equity, has experience with various coding paradigms (functional, object-oriented), enjoys discussing technology and its societal impacts, has a background in computer science, familiar with open-source projects, engaged in discussions about software development practices, has a nuanced understanding of economic theories, particularly Modern Monetary Theory, and has a history of using and promoting tools like TypeScript and RxJS.
